in_marathi.name: Chitrarathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Skillful in painting
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrarathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has the skill to create beautiful art, particularly with a paintbrush. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘chitra’ (painting) and ‘rathi’ (one who rides). In Hindu mythology, Chitrarathi is a name for the god Vishnu, who is often depicted as creating the universe with his divine paintbrush.
